Summarize a paniv fit

Source: R/paniv.R
summary.paniv.Rd

Summarize a paniv fit

Usage

# S3 method for class 'paniv'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

a "paniv" fit

...

unused

Value

an object of class "summary.paniv": a list with the coefficient table (coefficients: estimate, standard error, z value and p-value), first_stage, overid, ercomp, endogenous, instruments, varlist (Hausman-Taylor) and the fit information (call, model, nobs, n_groups, df.residual, vcov_type).

See also

Other paniv methods: predict.paniv(), vcov.paniv()

Examples

set.seed(2)
d <- data.frame(id = rep(1:50, each = 4), t = rep(1:4, 50))
d$z <- rnorm(200); d$u <- rnorm(200)
d$x <- d$z + d$u + rnorm(200); d$y <- 1 + d$x + d$u + rnorm(200)
summary(paniv(y ~ x | z, data = d, index = c("id", "t"), model = "within"))
#> 
#> Call:
#> paniv(formula = y ~ x | z, data = d, index = c("id", "t"), model = "within")
#> 
#> Estimator: fixed-effects 2SLS 
#> N = 200  groups = 50  vcov: classical 
#> Endogenous: x 
#> Excluded instruments: z 
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>   Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
#> x  1.14805    0.09381   12.24   <2e-16 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#> 
#> First stage (excluded instruments):
#>   partial.R2     F df1 df2   p.value
#> x     0.3623 84.66   1 149 2.971e-16
#> Residual df: 149 
#>
